influences.name: Kurt Vonnegut
influences.context: I can sum that up in two words, and those two words are "Kurt Vonnegut." If you read Kurt Vonnegut, and you don't immediately want to write like that, then I don't fucking want to know you, you know? Who wouldn't want to be silly but tap into the mysteries of the human spirit in this really economical way

influences.name: God Machine
influences.context: I remember, 21 years ago, coming down to Cardiff from where I'm from, and reading in Melody Maker a review of an album by a band called God Machine, the album is called Scenes from the Second Storey... I bought the tape... And I listened to it on a seven-hour train journey back home, and it was perfect.

influences.name: Klaus Prünster
influences.context: Later, I was signed to work with the best Austrian artists, including Klaus Prünster, Waterloo Studio Session, Falco, Andy Gebauer, Diana Jirkuf, Tröbinger Superfeucht, and Manfred Puchner Git from the One of a Kind Project 1979.

influences.name: Gerry Verano
influences.context: I'm glad I spoke with Gerry Verano. He introduced me to Sarah B, and I had the most beautiful collaborations.

influences.name: The Jesus Lizard
influences.context: lots of bands who maybe would have, certainly heard us, like we did with The Jesus Lizard, and stuff like that, taking that as an influence
